name: Char Aznable
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam Char's Counterattack
Char is one of the most feared pilots of the Principality of Zeon. In his final appearance in the Prime-UC in Char's Counterattack, he assumes leadership of the Neo Zeon movement, and becomes the titular antagonist of the film.
